scope: Complete static main-library source inventory and supplied-record reconciliation; selected fresh build/audit and sampled architectural/statement review. Not a fresh full-library build, complete statement review, or kernel-experiment reproduction.

fresh_sample.method: Direct Lean 4.35.0 compilation in dependency order, -j1 -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true; fresh isolated output directory supplied as LEAN_PATH. The supplied scripts/Audit.lean was run with only its aggregate import replaced by the two target imports. No source proof changes or prebuilt ADWH objects were used.
